meta.title: Fabian's Style — wholesale catalogue
meta.description: Fabian's Style women's wholesale catalogue. Original design, made in Poland. Wholesale prices and EAN codes for registered buyers.

site.priceNote: Wholesale prices excl. VAT, recommended retail prices incl. VAT
site.demoNotice: Demo catalogue: products, prices and EAN codes are illustrative.

footer.contactLead: Call or write — we will prepare terms, delivery dates and samples.

catalog.title: Wholesale collection
catalog.empty: No styles match the selected filters.
catalog.emptyCatalog: The collection is being prepared. Contact us to learn about the offer.

gate.title: Wholesale prices are for registered buyers
gate.lead: Create a business account — once verified you will see wholesale prices, recommended retail prices and EAN codes, and you can prepare a PDF line sheet.

product.quantityHint: Indicative quantity is optional — it is printed on the PDF line sheet.
product.add: {count, plural, =0 {Choose sizes} one {Add # size to line sheet} other {Add # sizes to line sheet}}

gate.title: Prices and EAN codes for wholesale buyers
gate.lead: Sign in to your business account to see the wholesale price, recommended retail price and EAN codes.

selection.title: Line sheet
selection.empty: Your line sheet is empty. Choose sizes on a product page to prepare a sheet with prices and EAN codes.

summary.partial: Value counts only lines with a quantity.

selection.limit: A line sheet can hold at most {max} lines.

form.title: PDF line sheet
form.lead: The PDF header will show your company details from your account, so your sales representative knows who prepared the order.
form.signInTitle: Sign in to create the PDF
form.signInLead: Line sheets with wholesale prices and EAN codes are available to registered buyers. Your selection will be kept.

done.title: Line sheet <ref>{reference}</ref> is ready
done.lead: Download the PDF and share it with your team. You will also find it in your account. Questions about delivery or terms? Contact your sales representative.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a short time. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.notSelectable: Some selected variants are no longer available. Remove them from the line sheet and try again.
errors.notFoundTitle: We could not find this page
errors.notFoundLead: The style may have been withdrawn from the collection.
errors.notActive: Your account is not active. Please contact your sales representative.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.download: The PDF could not be downloaded. Please try again.

consent.title: Privacy in the catalogue
consent.body: With your consent we store a random identifier in your browser to count visits and see which styles are popular. Without consent the catalogue works the same and statistics stay fully anonymous.
consent.necessary: We always remember your line sheet and this choice — on your device only.

account.passwordHint: At least 12 characters — a few easy-to-remember words work best.

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Business account for the Fabian's Style wholesale catalogue.

status.PENDING_EMAIL: Please confirm your e-mail address — we have sent a link to your inbox.
status.PENDING_APPROVAL: Your application is awaiting approval. We will e-mail you once your account is active.
status.REJECTED: We cannot activate this account. Please contact your sales representative.
status.SUSPENDED: This account is suspended. Please contact your sales representative.

login.resent: If the address is awaiting confirmation, we have sent a new link.

register.title: Create a business account
register.lead: The wholesale catalogue is for shops and businesses. Once you confirm your e-mail address, we will review your application and activate the account — then you will see wholesale prices and EAN codes.
register.terms: I accept the terms of use of the Fabian's Style wholesale catalogue.
register.privacy: I agree to Fabian's Style processing the data I provide to manage my account and for business contact. <policy>Privacy policy</policy>
register.doneLead: We have sent a confirmation link to {email}. Once you confirm it, your application goes to our team.
register.doneHint: Can't see the message? Check your spam folder or send the link again.

errors.taxId: Invalid number — check the VAT / tax number and the country.
errors.phone: Enter a phone number (at least 6 digits).
errors.password: The password must have 12 to 128 characters.
errors.consent: Tick both consents to create an account.

verify.doneLead: Your application has been passed to our team. We will e-mail you once your account is active.
verify.invalidTitle: The link has expired or has already been used
verify.invalidLead: If your account is still awaiting confirmation, send a new link.

reset.requestLead: Enter your account e-mail — we will send a link to set a new password.
reset.sent: If an account with this address exists, we have sent a link. It is valid for one hour.
reset.saved: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalid: The link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.

page.title: My account
page.companyHint: Your sales representative can change the company name, tax number and e-mail.
page.concurrent: The data has changed in the meantime — please reload the page.

password.title: Change password
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.

sheets.title: My line sheets
sheets.empty: You have no line sheets yet. Choose products in the catalogue and create a PDF.
